summary: Comprehensive backend (27/27 pytest passing) and frontend Playwright testing of 3 Star Provisional Store completed. Both Owner and Customer flows are functional end-to-end. All acceptance criteria met: login+redirects, wrong password error, 3 categories x 15 Tamil products, cart add/qty/+-/checkout, COD order lands on My Orders as Pending/Unpaid, UPI creates transaction, wishlist add/remove, admin analytics with Revenue/Profit/Bills cards, inline inventory edit (rate & stock), order status transitions Pending->Shipped->Delivered, mark-paid creating transaction, Sheets Sync page in local_fallback mode with copy button, role guard (/admin as customer -> /store; /api/analytics/summary 403 for customer). Fixed 3 minor React useEffect bugs that were causing 'destroy is not a function' console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 697 lines and starting to exceed the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth/products/orders/wishlist/analytics) and a store module before adding more features.

OrderBody.paymentMethod is a free-form string but backend behaviour branches on exact value 'UPI' while frontend sends 'Cash on Delivery' and 'UPI'. Consider Literal['UPI','Cash on Delivery'] to make the contract explicit.

Wishlist delete on Google Sheets mode uses store.delete_row by ProductID only which would remove the row for any customer with that product; the current safeguard scans wl first but the delete is still not user-scoped. Fine for local_fallback (uses composite key) but flag for future Sheets mode.
CORS allow_origins is read from env with '*' default combined with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; explicit origin should be set when auth cookies are ever used.
Login lockout state (_login_attempts) is in-memory only; won't survive backend restart or multi-worker deployments.
seed_data_creation: Test created several TEST_ orders and one TEST_ product (auto-deleted) during CRUD tests. Two Cash+Shipped/Delivered demo orders are present in DB from testing; leave alone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, xdist parallel, 27 tests, ~5s). App is in local_fallback mode intentionally (APPS_SCRIPT_URL not configured). Fixed 3 useEffect(load, deps) instances that were returning a Promise and causing React 'destroy is not a function' errors; if you touch admin Inventory/SheetsSetup or store Wishlist, keep the () => { load(); } pattern.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. Minor React warning ('destroy is not a function' + useEffect must not return anything besides a cleanup function) was due to useEffect(load, deps) where load() returns a Promise from api.get(...). Fixed by wrapping in a synchronous callback.
